audit_events_prev_hash_check.name: audit_events_prev_hash_check
audit_events_prev_hash_check.value: ("audit_events"."seq" = 1) = ("audit_events"."prev_hash" IS NULL) AND ("audit_events"."prev_hash" IS NULL OR octet_length("audit_events"."prev_hash") = 32)

outbox_dedupe_key_check.name: outbox_dedupe_key_check
outbox_dedupe_key_check.value: "outbox"."dedupe_key" IS NULL OR length("outbox"."dedupe_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 255

assessment_requests_submitted_check.name: assessment_requests_submitted_check
assessment_requests_submitted_check.value: "assessment_requests"."status" NOT IN ('submitted', 'promoted', 'rejected') OR ("assessment_requests"."sa_id" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("assessment_requests"."asset_ids") >= 1)

secrets_name_check.name: secrets_name_check
secrets_name_check.value: length("secrets"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND "secrets"."name" IS NFC NORMALIZED AND "secrets"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

secrets_external_locator_check.name: secrets_external_locator_check
secrets_external_locator_check.value: "secrets"."backend" NOT IN ('aws_kms', 'vault', 'aws_secrets_manager', 'azure_kv') OR "secrets"."external_locator" IS NOT NULL

secrets_has_value_check.name: secrets_has_value_check
secrets_has_value_check.value: "secrets"."status" = 'shredded' OR "secrets"."envelope" IS NOT NULL OR "secrets"."external_locator" IS NOT NULL

gate_decisions_decided_check.name: gate_decisions_decided_check
gate_decisions_decided_check.value:
("gate_decisions"."status" = 'pending' AND "gate_decisions"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "gate_decisions"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "gate_decisions"."auto" = false)
        OR ("gate_decisions"."status" <> 'pending' AND "gate_decisions"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("gate_decisions"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL OR "gate_decisions"."auto" = true))

authz_gate_decisions_sod_check.name: authz_gate_decisions_sod_check
authz_gate_decisions_sod_check.value: "authz_gate_decisions"."gate" = 3 OR "authz_gate_decisions"."decision" <> 'approved' OR ("authz_gate_decisions"."requester_id" IS NOT NULL AND "authz_gate_decisions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "authz_gate_decisions"."requester_id" <> "authz_gate_decisions"."actor_id")

assets_identifiers_array_check.name: assets_identifiers_array_check
assets_identifiers_array_check.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("assets"."identifiers") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("assets"."identifiers") >= 1 ELSE false END

assets_verified_evidence_check.name: assets_verified_evidence_check
assets_verified_evidence_check.value: "assets"."verification_status" <> 'verified' OR ("assets"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL AND "assets"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

runs_pause_fields_check.name: runs_pause_fields_check
runs_pause_fields_check.value: ("runs"."state" = 'paused') = ("runs"."pause_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "runs"."resume_to" IS NOT NULL)

test_cases_status_reason_check.name: test_cases_status_reason_check
test_cases_status_reason_check.value: "test_cases"."status" NOT IN ('removed', 'skipped', 'blocked', 'failed', 'model_declined', 'not_applicable') OR "test_cases"."status_reason" IS NOT NULL

test_cases_oracle_required_check.name: test_cases_oracle_required_check
test_cases_oracle_required_check.value: "test_cases"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'executing', 'executed') OR "test_cases"."oracle" IS NOT NULL

findings_mapped_check.name: findings_mapped_check
findings_mapped_check.value: "findings"."unmapped" OR ("findings"."cwe_id" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."owasp_category" IS NOT NULL)

findings_owasp_category_check.name: findings_owasp_category_check
findings_owasp_category_check.value: "findings"."owasp_category" IS NULL OR length("findings"."owasp_category") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

findings_location_check.name: findings_location_check
findings_location_check.value: jsonb_typeof("findings"."location") = 'object' AND ("findings"."location"->>'urlTemplate' IS NOT NULL OR "findings"."location"->>'file' IS NOT NULL) AND octet_length("findings"."location"::text) <= 8192

findings_released_check.name: findings_released_check
findings_released_check.value: "findings"."status" NOT IN ('released', 'fixed', 'returned') OR ("findings"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND "findings"."released_at" IS NOT NULL)

findings_narrative_check.name: findings_narrative_check
findings_narrative_check.value:
("findings"."description" IS NULL OR length("findings"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
        AND ("findings"."impact" IS NULL OR length("findings"."impact") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
        AND ("findings"."evidence_narrative" IS NULL OR length("findings"."evidence_narrative") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
        AND ("findings"."severity_rationale" IS NULL OR length("findings"."severity_rationale") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)
        AND ("findings"."remediation_summary" IS NULL OR length("findings"."remediation_summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

gate2_exceptions_sod_check.name: gate2_exceptions_sod_check
gate2_exceptions_sod_check.value: "gate2_exceptions"."state" <> 'approved_once' OR ("gate2_exceptions"."decided_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "gate2_exceptions"."requester_id" AND "gate2_exceptions"."decided_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "gate2_exceptions"."plan_approver_id")

cost_ledger_tokens_check.name: cost_ledger_tokens_check
cost_ledger_tokens_check.value:
"cost_ledger"."input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
        AND "cost_ledger"."output_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
        AND "cost_ledger"."cache_write_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
        AND "cost_ledger"."cache_read_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000
